name: Raffles Medical
summary: Islandwide clinic network many expats use for GP, health screening, and insurance-panel primary care.
body: Raffles Medical clinics are a common first GP relationship for newcomers who want English-first private care and islandwide coverage. Before you attach, confirm your employer insurer’s panel list, nearest clinic hours to home and office, and what to do after 10pm — clinic networks are not a substitute for knowing your closest appropriate A&E. Health screening packages are popular in year one; keep vaccination and chronic-medication records in the patient app. Pair with the healthcare GP/hospital guide for public vs private triage.
